coverage_policy.objective: Broad, auditable discovery of newly published public AI alignment research, preserving uncertain candidates for review.
coverage_policy.completeness: No finite registry, keyword query, publisher feed, or crawler establishes that all alignment research has been collected.
coverage_policy.history: Monitor new publications from the fixed start timestamp onward. Historical backfill is disabled; previously collected records remain preserved in the canonical archive.
known_gaps: Unindexed papers, private or paywalled material, personal sites outside the registry, missing publisher metadata, and non-English terminology.

Finite feed windows can lose publications during long outages. Existing undated publisher-index links are baselined without historical article crawling; their publication timing cannot be verified from the index alone.
Scholarly keyword searches trade precision for recall and still miss papers using unfamiliar terminology.
New sources require registration and validation; source success does not imply archive completeness.

Paginated discovery feeds use a bounded seven-day publication overlap. Items indexed later than that window or amid pagination churn can be missed. OpenReview search ordering is checked at runtime; unverifiable ordering is reported as degraded coverage.
research_scope: substantive Alignment Forum and LessWrong research posts
coverage_policy.review_policy: Opinion, news, uncertain relevance, and newly discovered items with uncertain publication timing remain candidates for review.

sources.coverage_note: Cross-category keyword search for new publications from the fixed cutoff. Query recall is incomplete. During API outages a visibly degraded, keyword-matched RSS backup covers the current announcement window in five categories; primary cursors do not advance.

sources.name: OpenReview
sources.coverage_note: Public API v2 paper submissions matching exact phrases. Forward discovery uses update metadata; publication metadata determines admission. API v1 venues and unfamiliar terminology may be missed; search ceilings are reported.

sources.name: Alignment Forum
sources.coverage_note: Public Alignment Forum posts from the fixed cutoff, including substantive informal research. Discussion and opinion remain review candidates.

sources.name: LessWrong
sources.coverage_note: New public posts are scanned broadly, avoiding reliance on incomplete alignment tags; relevance and research labels route unrelated discussion to review.

sources.name: METR
sources.coverage_note: New evaluations and methodology in the publisher RSS window; gaps during outages longer than that window may require recovery.

sources.name: Anthropic Alignment Science
sources.coverage_note: Publisher-owned article index monitored for newly listed or recently modified pages. Publication dates come from article metadata and bylines; existing undated links establish a baseline.

sources.name: Redwood Research
sources.coverage_note: New public Substack publications, with bounded forward catch-up pagination when necessary. Historical archive crawling is disabled.

sources.name: Transformer Circuits
sources.coverage_note: Lightweight publisher index checked hourly; explicit publication dates determine which cards are new after the fixed cutoff.

sources.name: FAR.AI
sources.coverage_note: Research URLs monitored in the publisher sitemap. New or recently modified pages are fetched; original publication bylines override migration dates. Historical article rotation is disabled.

sources.name: Apollo Research
sources.coverage_note: New science, monitoring and governance research pages from the publisher sitemap. Existing undated URLs establish a baseline; old article rotation is disabled.

sources.name: Alignment Research Center
sources.coverage_note: New research-blog URLs discovered through the publisher post sitemap. Existing undated URLs establish a baseline; historical article rotation is disabled.

sources.name: MIRI
sources.coverage_note: Publisher RSS mixes technical alignment work, policy, organizational updates and newsletters; new non-research entries remain review candidates.

sources.name: MIRI Publications
sources.coverage_note: Official technical bibliography monitored for newly added citations. Year-only dates are preserved; uncertain new publication timing requires review. Existing citations establish a baseline.

sources.name: OpenAI
sources.coverage_note: Publisher-wide feed includes safety research alongside products and company news; new non-research entries remain review candidates.

sources.name: Google DeepMind
sources.coverage_note: Publisher-wide blog includes technical safety and general AI news; new uncertain matches remain review candidates and outages are bounded by its feed window.
